reason: Pre-trial amendment: V1 assumed a daily FRED BAA series for the decomposition leg; the fetch showed FRED publishes BAA monthly only (286 rows, 2003-01 to 2026-10, verified from the raw CSV payload), so no daily BAA series exists to fetch. V2 drops the BAA fetch leg from the universe and derives the daily BAA change from the identity ΔBAA = ΔBAA10Y + ΔDGS10 instead; given the lag-2 guard, the lagged-ΔBAA supplementary regression is a restatement of the primary test, not independent evidence. No change to the predictor, target, guard, control, verdict criteria, windows or test family. Discovered during the fetch (pre-trial data contact) and registered before any result was examined.
T0020: Holm-adjusted primary p=0.1819, partial R2=0.000576 < 0.005, holdout OOS incremental R2=-0.004563; all three preregistered acceptance criteria failed.
